title: Notify
statement: Implement `solve(channels, message)`. `channels` is a list of `email` or `sms`. Send `message` through each. Email returns `email:message`. SMS returns `sms:message`. Return the list of those results. Do not branch on the channel name inside the sender loop. Look up an object and call `send`.
hints: Two small classes each implement send.
Map the name to an instance.
Append channel.send(message) in a loop with no isinstance check.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Polymorphism here is one method name and two implementations.

editorial: Polymorphism here is one method name and two implementations. The loop does not grow when a third channel appears. A type switch in the loop is the design this function replaces. The prefix in the result shows which implementation ran.
